display.title: T3: The Chemical Crystallizer
display.subtitle: 5x ore, the final stage
description: The §bChemical Crystallizer§r is the §b5x§r step. A Chemical Dissolution
Chamber dissolves ore in sulfuric acid, a Chemical Washer cleans the
slurry, and the Crystallizer makes five crystals from each ore. The
crystals then run the 4x line: injection, purification, crusher, enrichment.
Build a Chemical Crystallizer to complete this quest and finish the chain the
whole Engineering lane has climbed toward.
§7With the full line you reach true 5x ore, the apex of T3 processing.
